title: Wikipedia-Nisiyama-Onsen-705AD.jpg
author: Boltor
description: Outside picture, taken in 2020, of Nishiyama Onsen Keiunkan a hot spring hotel in Hayakawa, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. Founded in 705 AD, it is the oldest hotel in the world. In 2011, the hotel was officially recognized by the Guinness World Records as the oldest hotel in the world.
